canonical_title: Pitch control power throughout the range of attainable angle of attack

versions.title_at_revision: Pitch control power throughout the range of attainable angle of attack
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's control power, control surface rate, and hinge moment capability is sufficient for recovery throughout the range of attainable AOA to prevent the occurrence of a deep stall. For all normal states, the air vehicle exhibits no deep stall trim point within the CG limits and has no objectionable nose-up or nose-down recovery characteristics, such as positive or negative AOA hang-up. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess aerodynamic control power, control surface rate, and hinge moment capability as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Margin paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess that aerodynamic control power, control surface rate, and hinge moment capability as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Margin paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess that aerodynamic control power, control surface rate, and hinge moment capability as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Margin paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
